harm_description: Unauthorised disclosure of employee personal data could lead to identity theft, discrimination, or financial loss
existing_safeguards: Role-based access, encryption at rest, annual access reviews, NDAs with processors
additional_measures: Implement automated retention deletion, enhance audit logging
scoring_method: Likelihood (1-5) × Severity (1-5) = Inherent Risk. Residual calculated after controls. Thresholds: 1-4 Low, 5-9 Medium, 10-15 High, 16-25 Critical
